description: Finds cache breaks in a session -- turns where the prompt-cache prefix was not reused, so the context was re-written at cache-write prices instead of read back cheaply. A break is a spike in cache writes AND a drop in cache reads; a write spike alone (e.g. reading one large file) is not one. Each break lists the turn, token counts, likely cause (model or speed switch, idle past the 5-minute TTL, or an early-context change such as an edited CLAUDE.md), and its API-equivalent write premium from the pricing table. Also returns the overall cache hit rate and reads-per-write.

baselineWindow.description: Number of previous turns to average for the baseline.

includeSubagents.description: Also analyze subagent/sidechain turns, baselined separately from main turns since they keep their own cache. Defaults to false.

minCacheWrites.description: Minimum absolute cache writes on a turn to consider (filters noise).

sessionId.description: Session ID (full or unambiguous prefix) to analyze.

spikeThreshold.description: Minimum spike ratio (current writes / rolling average) to flag as a break.
